conclusion.statement: The monolithic single-item model fails above the documented item-size limit. The semantic aggregate model stores the same orders with the largest item at 35.5% of the limit and no array chunking required. The item-size limit is therefore a constraint on the DOCUMENT MODEL, not a disqualifier for Cosmos DB.
